implant-single-tooth.body: Placeholder testimonial. I lost a molar years ago and put off doing anything about it. The assessment explained what was involved and what it would cost before I committed to anything. The implant itself was far less of an ordeal than I had built it up to be, and I stopped noticing it within a fortnight.

all-on-4-full-arch.body: Placeholder testimonial. I had been wearing a lower denture for six years and had stopped eating anything that needed real chewing. Having a fixed bridge fitted the same day the implants went in made the decision much easier to face. Six months on I eat normally and do not think about my teeth.

invisalign-adult.body: Placeholder testimonial. I wanted my front teeth straightened at forty-one without a mouth full of metal at work. The aligners came out for meetings and meals, which was the whole reason I went ahead. It took eleven months and the retainer routine afterwards was explained properly at the start.
